name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Urgent need to revise the medical devices regulation
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to fix problems with the EU rules on medical devices. These rules were meant to make devices safer, but they have caused delays, shortages and trouble for small companies. The Parliament wants the Commission to act by early 2025 and to review the rules properly. It also wants faster approval for new devices, fairer fees, clearer timelines and better support for small firms and for devices for children and rare diseases. This is a request, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks the Commission to propose fixes by early 2025; no law changes yet.
- Patients, makers of medical devices, and the bodies that approve them are affected.
- Next: the Commission decides whether to propose new rules or changes.
